title: Concrete scalar extension and normalized finite reduction systems
statement: Use the twice-lifted rings $A_r$ and quotient maps of [def-per-finite-reduction-coefficients]. For an essentially small site $J$ and a commutative ring map $f:A\to B$ in the module universe, define $E_f$ as sheafification of sectionwise scalar extension and give its extension/restriction adjunction. A DerivedExtension is a functor $D(A)\to D(B)$ with a universal left-derived counit $Q L E_f\to E_f Q$, invertible on every K-flat complex. On the etale and pro-etale sites, ordinaryComparison is the unique comparison between the two left adjoints of the same scalar restriction/site restriction functor. ordinaryAssociator is the analogous comparison for a composite quotient map. A System consists of such DerivedExtensions for all quotient maps, comparison isomorphisms and associators, with their specified equations on flat K-flat representatives. CoherentAt is the equality between the two comparison-associator routes at a derived object. Finally realize is the canonical exact realization in constant-ring modules of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin]. These are concrete functors and a structure interface, with no witness chosen from an unproved existence statement.
